observations.topic: bidi: the age's leading numeral merges into the preceding Latin run on the composed card line
observations.detail: Measured with FriBidi under the app's RTL base: on the composed card line 'Damian Tran · 3 دن پہلے اپ ڈیٹ کیا گیا' the digit maps to visual 37 of 38 while the rest of the age maps 15..22 and the verb 0..13, because U+0033 joins the preceding LTR island. The reading order is still correct (the LTR island is read first as 'Damian Tran · 3', then the RTL continuation دن پہلے, then the verb), and the digit's visual place relative to دن is the same as in an all-RTL line. With FSI/PDI around the message the numeral stays contiguous with its unit inside the isolate; agent-card.tsx and org-teams-list.tsx apply no isolate, unlike browser-tab-strip.tsx and hub-skills-library.tsx. Not a copy defect and not a finding: {when} is the shipped age phrase and the call site owns isolation.

observations.topic: fit: the reorder changes which end a single-line RTL ellipsis cuts
observations.detail: Before the fix the age occupied the leftmost columns of the composed card line (visual 0..8), so an ellipsis cut the age first; now the verb occupies 0..13 and the age 15..37, so a truncation would cut the verb instead. That is the trade both sidecars invite ('ONE whole sentence, so the language can put the time before the verb') and it protects the age, which is the row's information. On the teams row the verb is also the created/updated discriminator, so a truncation there would cost that distinction; no rendered frame was captured, so no truncation is claimed. Follow-up, if ever observed, belongs to the call site (isolation or width), not to this copy.

observations.topic: clock-skew arm: fronted absolute date without کو
observations.detail: recencyOf() substitutes a formatted short date for {when} when the timestamp is in the future, composing '10 اکتوبر، 2026 اپ ڈیٹ کیا گیا'. Urdu datelines commonly write the bare date before the passive verb; the source is equally clipped ('updated Oct 10, 2026'). Adding کو is impossible inside this template because the relative arm would become '3 دن پہلے کو'. Accepted; the arm is reachable only on a skewed timestamp.

observations.topic: grammar: impersonal masculine passive in the created arm
observations.detail: '{when} بنایا گیا' uses the impersonal masculine passive although ٹیم is feminine and the agreeing form would be بنائی گئی. The object is elided and the verb is byte-identical to the same expanded row's shipped ui.hub.teams.detail.created (and to ui.library.origin.created / ui.agents.config.summary.created), so this is the surface's established impersonal form; changing it would be a surface-wide style call, not a defect in this delta. Recorded so the next wave does not re-open it as new.

bidi_review.conclusion: Reading order is correct in every composed case: the age occupies the right end of the message and the verb the left, which is what Urdu word order requires (time phrase then passive verb). The absolute date renders as 10 اکتوبر، 2026 in RTL reading (year leftmost), the Latin author and middle dot stay a single LTR island, and no punctuation, numeral or quote lands at the wrong end. The one measured bidi artefact — the age's leading digit joining the preceding LTR island on the composed card line — is benign (O1).

icu_structure: No value in the delta carries a plural/select: the only ICU argument is {when}, and its name is identical to the English source in all five. The composed age phrases come from shipped ur keys with one/other (ur CLDR categories) — unchanged by this delta.

terminology_rulings.basis: Idiomatic Urdu for manual work (ہاتھ سے لکھا / ہاتھ سے بنا). Codepoints are the Urdu forms: ہ U+06C1, ھ U+06BE, ے U+06D2, ٹ U+0679; no Arabic heh/yeh/kaf variants. Distinct from the roster button's خود, which mirrors English 'manually' vs 'by hand'.

Same passive as the same surface's shipped ui.hub.teams.detail.updated and ui.agents.config.summary.updated (4 shipped uses). The intransitive اپ ڈیٹ ہوا used on ui.code_review.age.*/ui.hub.updates is a different construction, not a competing term for this surface.
Byte-identical verb to the same expanded row's ui.hub.teams.detail.created; keeps the created arm distinguishable from the updated arm, as the sidecar requires.

terminology_rulings.item: relative age before the passive verb
terminology_rulings.basis: Shipped time-first keys: ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.worked_when_with_tools ('{when} کام کیا · {tools}'), ui.code_review.age.days/hours/minutes ('{amountText} دن پہلے اپ ڈیٹ ہوا'), ui.hub.updates.detail.applied_ago ('{ago} اپ ڈیٹ ہوا۔'). Urdu is verb-final, so a post-verbal age is the marked, source-order calque.
